en: Black‑and‑white view of a narrow, richly carved half‑timbered Renaissance house with a steep tiled roof and small dormer windows. The façade is covered with ornate wooden reliefs and figures between rows of windows with lace curtains. The ground floor is a shop with large display windows full of ceramics and household goods, and a central arched entrance. The building is flanked by similar old houses on a cobbled street in a historic European town.
